text:
Maria G: Quick kickoff — ACME + Redwood joint webinar planned for May 15. Need final speaker roster, demo owners, and a fallback for demos. Who can confirm availability?
Alex Ryan: I can lead the live product walkthrough. Target 12 min + 5 min Q&A. Need access to partner sandbox by Tue.
Priya K: I'll manage partner comms and swag. Proposed split: 150 stickers, 60 tees, 40 notepads. Partner will cover customs. Need shirt sizes by Wed.
Josh P: AV & lab owner here. Will run the staging + breakout rooms. Can we lock run-of-show by Friday EOD?
Ellen M: Marketing wants a co-branded landing page + UTM links. Assets due by Thu. I'll draft email copy.
Maria G: Speaker backups — if Alex gets pulled, can Josh step in for the product overview?
Alex Ryan: I can if needed, but prefer Josh handle live infra troubleshooting.
Priya K: Logistics question: courier pickup window is Wed morning. @LogisticsOps can you confirm label generation & customs docs?
LogisticsOps: Confirmed — labels queued, customs form attached to ticket. Courier ETA Wed 09:30 local.
Sam Ops Bot: [reminder] Dev sandbox provisioning scheduled: 2026-05-12 02:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.ai/event-assets/sandboxes
Josh P: Fallback demo plan: pre-record 6-min walkthrough + live Q&A. Will upload video to bucket and have a short intro slide.
Maria G: Can we add a rehearsal with partner PM and their engineer? Suggested Tue 11am PT.
Ellen M: Also need speaker bios + headshots by Wed. I'll put a doc in the shared drive.
Alex Ryan: For the perf portion we'll need dedicated sandbox: 8 vCPU, 32GB RAM, 1 x A10G. @Eng Infra please advise on provisioning ETA.
Eng Infra: Ticket #12345 created for the sandbox. ETA 48 hours after approval.
Priya K: Swag packing list + sticker lanes: I'll prepare a manifest and labels. Also want a tiny postcard with trial code. Partner approved a promo code.
Ellen M: Good — add the promo code to the post-event follow-up template. We'll A/B test two subject lines.
Josh P: AV checklist: HDMI adapters, mics, 2 spare laptops. Label all demo devices. I'll add this to the runbook.
Maria G: Legal note: partner still reviewing co-brand slides. Can someone try the standardized co-marketing template to speed up signoff?
Alex Ryan: Use the template from last cloud partner webinar — legal cleared it faster. Link: https://redwood.ai/templates/comarketing
Priya K: Press embargo is on — no external announcements before event day. Partner agreed.
Sam Ops Bot: Reminder: create Zoom webinar link and internal staging meeting. Also add co-host rights to partner marketer.
Ellen M: I'll own the promo cadence: 2 emails + social + partner channels. Can partners provide 1 quote and a short case blurb?
Priya K: Confirmed — partner will provide a quote by Wed EOD.
Josh P: Dry run scheduled Tue 11am PT. Will invite presenters, partner PM, and infra. Expect ~30 minutes.
Maria G: Thanks everyone. Next sync Fri 9am PT. If blockers pop up, ping me directly. :rocket:
Ellen M: Uploaded the landing mock to the drive — pls review and drop comments.
Priya K: Packing checklist sent to LogisticsOps. Will attach customs declaration and shirt sizes list.
LogisticsOps: Received. Will confirm pickup once labels printed.
Alex Ryan: Final ask — can someone record the rehearsal so partner can review?
Josh P: Yes, will record and drop into the event bucket. Path will be: gs://ri-event-assets/2026/may15/rehearsal.mp4
Maria G: Awesome. Closing notes: run-of-show link in thread, speaker backups noted, swag manifest in drive, rehearsal Tue 11am. See you Friday sync. :thumbsup:
